model: RandomForestClassifier (500 trees, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values; 80/20 stratified split
notes: followup_score was excluded because it appears to be recorded after diagnosis (it alone gives ~0.93 accuracy and separates classes almost perfectly), so it would be leakage. Zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin and bmi were treated as missing.
